title: Great app, great functionality
body:
Honestly it is a great application while taking into consideration its functionality and the simplicity. But, it is greedy as hell making people pay to have more than 15 check ins per week.
Like fr, put a price on the application instead of making it free, but depriving people from using the core concepts.
author: not__you
